scope: Post-hoc saved-checkpoint structural-control study; no CNN training and no fresh validation claim

definitions.gradient: Signed sample-count-weighted mean data-loss gradient, accumulated in float32 before absolute products; same original microbatch 128
definitions.norm_product: U_l = L2(weight_l) * L2(mean_gradient_l), biases excluded. Three-block proxy shares use sum of four U plus epsilon; shallow=conv1, deep=conv3+head
definitions.marginals: CPU float64 diagnostics on flattened float32 tensors: mean absolute value, signed population SD, median absolute magnitude and linear-interpolated 90th percentile absolute magnitude
definitions.norms: CPU float64 L2 weight and mean-gradient norms for each of conv1/conv2/conv3/head
definitions.bias: Original total bias L2 norm and absolute weight-gradient sensitivity, last/mean/population SD; shared in M and MZ
definitions.Z: Exactly six shallow/deep share last, mean, population SD; actual fixed checkpoint schedule, initialization excluded; no slopes
definitions.models: E uses original development-selected input columns. B=E+total4. L2=B+share endpoints. L6=B+Z. N=B+norm-product proxy six summaries. NZ=N+Z. M=N+four-layer weight/gradient L2 and marginal summaries+shared bias6. MZ=M+Z. Each pair shares learner/grid/folds/candidates; no generator attributes enter predictors

selection: Development grouped OOF discoveries at floor(N/3), then AP, then first/smaller grid value; post-hoc choice motivated by consumed diagnostics, never presented as original primary endpoint
folds: Reuse exact original family memberships for each cohort/prefix; verify train and validation labels both represented
uncertainty: Paired whole-family draws from all ten held-out families, nested runs together, duplicate families get occurrence identity; recompute N/k/rankings; empty and single-label draws excluded and counted. Conditional exploratory pointwise percentile intervals, no selection uncertainty
panel_B: Frozen new A pipelines on B plus matched B-development refit using A-selected hyperparameters only; original frozen pipelines never modified
interpretation: Software correctness gates interpretation. Positive MZ-M is exploratory evidence of conditional added value for the bounded learner and bank, not proof of unique information or causality. No gain narrows the contribution; panel/family changes and high dimension versus n must remain explicit. No fresh study, Waterbirds or proposal modification is authorised by this stage
